# ReConflict / Desert Storm attribution

The ReThing adapts runtime, controller and build techniques from the ReConflict
(Conflict: Desert Storm) project: https://github.com/rzrbld/ReConflict.
The upstream project MIT license is retained in LICENSE. The controller bridge
also retains its original eSKylezZ notice in probe/LICENSE.desert-pad-source.
No Desert Storm game files are included.
